name: facebook-army
description: Local Facebook account station for client management via AI API

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n api,dash -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @facebook-army/api" "npm run dev -w @facebook-army/dashboard"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @facebook-army/shared && npm run build -w @facebook-army/api && npm run build -w @facebook-army/dashboard
